description: Arceaux pour vélos cargos sur la commune du Haillan is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville Le Haillan. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-02-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
